text:
sara-cs: Heads up — customer ACCT-6672 reports their 14-day trial credits dropped to 0 immediately after we migrated them to the Starter plan this morning. They claim their trial end date is still 2026-04-10 and they didn't hit any quota. Can someone look? :confused:

ryan-support: thanks, sara. can you paste the account id + a short repro? any error they saw on API calls?

sara-cs: account: ACCT-6672. repro steps from the customer:
1) hit POST /v1/generate with trial key -> returns 200 but response shows \"remaining_credits\": 0
2) account page still shows trial_end: 2026-04-10
They attached a curl example, here's the response snippet:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c",
  "usage": {"tokens": 342},
  "remaining_credits": 0,
  "trial_end": "2026-04-10T23:59:59Z"
}
```

No billing transaction logged at the time they say migration occurred. Customer says they didn't click upgrade.

ops-bot: auto-detected account change: migration event for ACCT-6672 at 2026-03-03T08:12:03Z (service: plan-migration). No payment processed.

mike-billing: looking. quick policy note: we can do manual reinstatements for trial credit loss caused by platform-side migration within 72h. need manager sign-off and a short audit log entry. please confirm the amount to restore.

ryan-support: propose restoring 500 trial credits (original allotment). jess-manager can you sign off? I'll prepare the billing ticket with the logs.

jess-manager: approved +1. go ahead with manual grant and note reason: \"credits removed by migration event; customer did not upgrade\". keep it to 500 credits.

mike-billing: done — manually granted 500 trial credits to ACCT-6672. admin action id: ACT-94231. entry added to audit: \"manual_grant:500; reason:migration_recovery; actor:mike-billing; ticket:CS-8817\".

sara-cs: passed update to customer. they say their dashboard now shows remaining_credits: 500 and generation calls are succeeding again. they asked what caused it so we should follow up with infra. :relieved:

ryan-support: thanks — filing infra bug: INF-2042 to investigate plan-migration flow that cleared credits incorrectly. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

sara-cs: closing loop with the customer. asked if they'd like a short post-mortem once INF-2042 has details.

mike-billing: FYI flagged this for monthly audit to ensure we catch any other similar migrations.

sara-cs: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
